behavioral_target: Holding, pursuing, or over-giving from one side without checking whether effort is returned.
canonical_protocol: Hold your effort back a little, watch how much the other person gives back, then match what you give to what they give.
notes: Normalizes the reach-first / over-effort family (c2, c4, c5, c15) into one pacing protocol.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Pace effort to observed reciprocity

behavioral_target: Brushing off kind, available people before giving them a real look.
canonical_protocol: Before you count someone kind out, ask if it is really no spark or just someone new, and give it a little more time before you decide.
notes: Split out of the c5 reciprocity play (Play10).
core_play_name_internal_prev: Don't dismiss available people before checking

behavioral_target: Pushing past a real worry or warning instead of checking it.
canonical_protocol: When something worries you, name what you saw, then watch it or ask about it before you get more serious.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Check a worry before deciding

behavioral_target: Staying or waiting on hope without a set point to look at what really changed.
canonical_protocol: Pick ahead of time what you need to see, and by when, then look at what really happened and decide.
notes: Normalizes the see-by-date / give-another-chance family (c5, c11, c14, c24).
core_play_name_internal_prev: Set a see-by date, then decide

behavioral_target: Making excuses for a partner instead of naming what really happened.
canonical_protocol: When you catch yourself making an excuse for them, stop and name what actually happened first.
notes: Split out of the c11 acceptance play (Play20).
core_play_name_internal_prev: Name what actually happened before explaining it away

behavioral_target: Hiding, guarding, or acting fine instead of sharing a small true thing and watching the response.
canonical_protocol: Share one small, true thing with a safe person, then watch how they take it before you share more.
notes: Normalizes the guardedness / hiding / acting-fine family (c1, c3, c8, c14, c17, c23, c27).
core_play_name_internal_prev: Graduated self-disclosure with observation

behavioral_target: Leaving first to avoid being left, before seeing how the other person shows up.
canonical_protocol: When you want to leave first, name what is making you want to pull away, then wait and watch how they show up before you decide.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Wait and watch before leaving first

core_play_name_internal: Direct Clarification In Place of Testing
behavioral_target: Testing a partner instead of asking for what you need in plain words.
canonical_protocol: Instead of testing, ask for what you need in plain words, then watch how they answer.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Ask directly instead of testing

behavioral_target: Checking, scanning, or surveilling instead of asking and watching real actions over time.
canonical_protocol: Instead of checking, ask the one thing you want to know, then let their real actions over time show you the answer.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Get a real answer instead of checking; observe real actions over time

core_play_name_internal: Restraint and Issue Triage Before Re-litigation
behavioral_target: Reopening an old hurt on a loop instead of pausing to see if a real issue is left.
canonical_protocol: When you want to reopen an old hurt, pause and ask if one real thing is left to work out; if yes, name it plainly; if not, let it rest for now.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Pause before reopening an old hurt; name if there is a real issue

behavioral_target: Checking an ex, or dwelling, as a grief/rumination urge with no time limit.
canonical_protocol: When you feel the urge to check or dwell, name what you feel, then wait it out or set a time limit, and see how each day goes.
notes: Recovery phase has no framework competencies (source gap).
core_play_name_internal_prev: Time-box a grief or rumination checking urge

behavioral_target: Carrying or starting everything instead of doing your part and leaving room for theirs.
canonical_protocol: Do your part, then stop, and leave room for the other person to carry their share.
notes: Normalizes the imbalance / over-functioning family (c7, c10, c14, c15).
core_play_name_internal_prev: Do your part and leave room for their share

behavioral_target: Avoiding or going quiet on a hard thing instead of naming it.
canonical_protocol: Pick one hard thing you have been avoiding and say it in a calm, clear way instead of going quiet.
notes: Competency normalized to Conflict Navigation where the phase has competencies.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Name a hard thing instead of avoiding it

behavioral_target: Going along with things instead of saying no and asking for what you need.
canonical_protocol: Pick one need or one no, and say it or ask for it in a calm, clear way.
notes: c14 behaviors span Integration and Cross-Phase; treated as Cross-Phase for competency.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Say no and ask for what you need directly

behavioral_target: Over-apologizing out of habit for things that are not your fault.
canonical_protocol: Save 'sorry' for when you really did something wrong; when it is not your fault, say what you mean instead.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Save sorry for real faults

behavioral_target: Waiting for full certainty instead of taking a small step and letting the rest show.
canonical_protocol: Pick one small step you can take now, even without feeling fully sure, and let the rest show itself over time.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Take a small step before feeling fully sure

behavioral_target: Minimizing real differences because you care, instead of letting them count.
canonical_protocol: Name real differences plainly, even when you care, then look at whether you both can truly live with them.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Let real differences count

behavioral_target: Drifting out of dating from hopelessness instead of choosing a break on purpose.
canonical_protocol: Notice if a dating break is a rest you chose or a way to avoid dating, then pick how long to rest and check in with yourself.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Choose dating breaks on purpose

behavioral_target: Managing or controlling ahead of time instead of letting things unfold and watching.
canonical_protocol: Let one small thing stay open and watch what really happens instead of managing it ahead of time.
core_play_name_internal_prev: Let things unfold instead of managing ahead

behavioral_target: Staying even when part of you knows it isn't good for you, instead of deciding by fit.
canonical_protocol: When you notice you are staying even though part of you knows it isn't good for you, name that, then decide by fit, not by that pull to stay.
notes: Mechanism fix applied ('staying out of fear' removed).
core_play_name_internal_prev: Decide by fit, not by staying to avoid ending
